facts.fact: A named analyst (Patrice Sané) says that seven months after launch more than three in four Starlink kits are installed in urban areas (Dakar, Mbour, Diourbel), at over 160,000 FCFA for the kit and about 30,000 FCFA a month; analyst, not regulator, source.
The analyst states the Starlink licence is currently suspended by the Supreme Court in summary proceedings.
